scientific.integrity: The primary full PDF was inspected at the model assumptions, nondimensional parameter definitions, boundedness theorem, Theorem 2, conditions (5)-(6), and the definitions of M_i and R_i. Related multi-prey permanence literature was checked for context. The bundled checker replays the algebraic certificate. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding proves that the sufficient hypotheses of Theorem 2 are mutually incompatible. It does not prove that the model is never permanent and does not derive a replacement sharp permanence criterion.

title: The published permanence criterion is algebraically impossible
